corrections.value: The Chi-Cheemaun ferry between Tobermory and South Baymouth operates seasonally. Check the operator’s current sailing schedule, reservation opening date and vehicle-booking conditions before planning your crossing; do not assume year-round sailings.
corrections.quote: The 2026 Sailing Season has ended. Reservations open March 2027.
corrections.reason: The current date is 2026-11-15, and the source explicitly states the 2026 season is over and bookings are unavailable until March 2027.

summary: The existence of the Chi-Cheemaun ferry route between Tobermory and Manitoulin Island (South Baymouth) is well-supported. However, as of the current date (November 15, 2026), the ferry service is closed for the season and will not reopen for bookings until March 2027. All specific trail names, local geography (alvars, waterfalls), and specific bridge operations on the island are unverified as the provided tourism source was corrupted/invalid and the ferry source is limited to transit operations.
